refresh_cookie.name: pantheon_refresh_token
refresh_cookie.value: opaque 'pdr1.' + random; server stores SHA-256 only

endpoints.POST /bff/auth/dev-login: browser_session=true + allowed Origin; body has expires_at and refresh_expires_at, no tokens
endpoints.POST /bff/auth/refresh: allowed Origin required (403 otherwise); 200 reissues access cookie and rotates refresh cookie; 401 on reuse(revokes chain)/expired/revoked/unknown/identity changed; 403 where dev login forbidden. Response: data.session.expires_at, data.session.refresh_expires_at, data.expires_at, data.refresh_expires_at
endpoints.POST /bff/logout: revokes chain via refresh_chain access claim or presented refresh cookie; deletes both cookies

contract.frontend_notes: Refresh cookie is only sent to /bff/auth/*; call POST /bff/auth/refresh (credentials: include) before expires_at or on 401. Logout after the access cookie expired cannot reach the chain via the /bff/logout path (cookie is path-scoped); call refresh first, or the chain simply expires at refresh_expires_at.
